recognize_zh: 高倍切片中粉紅色無定形膠狀基質佔滿背景，殘存的造血細胞稀疏散布，可見分葉中性球、帶狀核、紅血球前驅細胞與小脂肪空泡，符合骨髓膠狀轉化中殘餘的造血成分。
features: Pale eosinophilic amorphous ground substance filling the intercellular space
Sparse residual trilineage-type cells: segmented and band neutrophils, myeloid precursors and small round erythroid precursors
Occasional larger cell with vesicular nucleus, possibly an immature myeloid cell or macrophage
A few cells containing fine brown pigment, suggestive of hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Small clear vacuoles consistent with atrophic adipocytes and congested vessels
describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows abundant pale eosinophilic amorphous extracellular material. Residual hematopoietic cells are sparse and scattered, including maturing neutrophils (bands and segmented forms), myeloid precursors and small erythroid precursors, with occasional pigment-containing macrophages and small atrophic fat vacuoles. The residual cells lack atypia and no infiltrate is identified. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation of the marrow with residual maturing hematopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence and often perivascular, unlike this Alcian blue-positive mucoid matrix.
Necrosis shows degenerated ghost cells and karyorrhectic debris rather than intact maturing granulocytes.
Fibrosis shows reticulin/collagen fibers with atypical megakaryocytes and streaming, rather than an amorphous matrix with atrophic fat.
